title: Quentin and the Parish
author: Bram Amberdale
blurb: Emrys Vasquez, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
